titles.ko: 관측량과 항의 크기에 맞춘 양자 동역학 계산
titles.en: Quantum dynamics tailored to observables and Hamiltonian scales

descriptions.ko: 목표 관측량에 맞춘 무작위 항 선택과 항별 노름을 이용한 결정론적 시간발전 분할을 구분합니다. 정확한 한 큐비트 계산으로 오차 차수·편향·분산과 연산 수를 비교하고, 한 관측량의 개선이 다른 관측량에는 불리할 수 있음을 보입니다. 분자 벤치마크와 교육 모형의 범위를 함께 설명합니다.
descriptions.en: Observable-specific stochastic sampling and norm-aware deterministic splitting target different errors. Exact one-qubit calculations compare order, bias, variance and exponential counts, including a distribution that improves one observable while worsening another.

Editorial harness
AI Tech Review Editorial Harness v2026.08 · public method
Verification scope
StateDRIFT arXiv:2610.31515v1 and norm-aware product-formula arXiv:2610.31070v1; formula order, benchmark initial states, times, denominators and molecular conditions crosschecked.; Exact one-qubit product formulas and stochastic first/second moments, 27-trajectory enumeration and independent SO(3) moment calculation; educational oracle distribution is not the StateDRIFT allocator.; Bilingual equations, original desktop/mobile figures, generated conceptual cover, complete HTML/PDF output, metadata, archive hashes and live links. No molecular benchmark, StateDRIFT allocator or QPU reproduction; no cost-matched native-gate or measurement-shot benchmark.
Human review record
Topic, development and public posting explicitly requested; no line-by-line human approval or reader-comprehension study.
Evidence cutoff
2026-10-26

Partial–Strang and full Strang orders, state error and observable MSE, trajectories and measurement shots are distinguished. Reported speedups from the two methods are not multiplied. The teaching calculation is an exact one-qubit oracle search, not molecular performance or a reproduction of StateDRIFT. Flat bandwidth does not imply a small operator norm or commutator. Arcs, slivers and the aperture in the AI-generated cover are analogies for design choices, not actual circuits or numerical results.
